title: Activating hexagonal boron nitride monolayers for efficient hydrogen evolution reaction by strong interfacial interactions with 2D M2X electrides
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4SE01604A, Paper
Siyao Wang, Jingxiang Zhao
Anchoring h-BN monolayer on metal-based electride substrates can enhance its electrical conductivity and regulate its catalytic activity for hydrogen evolution reactions.
